description: Generates a chat completion using a Large Language Model (LLM). Effect: triggers a server-side action rather than a plain resource creation — whether repeating it is safe, a no-op, or rejected depends on the specific action; treat it as not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

items.description: A message in the LLM completion generation request or response.

role.description: Role of the message sender, e.g., 'user' or 'assistant.'

model.description: Name of the LLM to use. If not specified, the default model will be used, if available.

responseFormat.description: Response format for LLM completion generation.

schema.description: The JSON schema to use when type is 'jsonSchema'.

type.description: Type of the response format. Defaults to 'text'.

name: generateCompletion

outputSchema.description: Response body for LLM completion generation.

data.description: The result of a completion generation request.

message.description: A message in the LLM completion generation request or response.

role.description: Role of the message sender, e.g., 'user' or 'assistant.'
